{{Locations|Zoltan Controlled Sector|Zoltan Homeworlds|distress=truenoperiod|asteroidfield=true|LRSmap=noship+asteroidfield|unique=true}}


''Your jump interrupts a Zoltan security ship as it follows a Mantis pirate into an asteroid field. They message you, "Your presence here will continue to be tolerated - but please, do not interfere."''
# Interfere and save the Mantis ship.
#* ''Sometimes you have to bet on the underdog - even on the rare occasions that the underdog is a Mantis warship. You set off for the heart of the asteroid field and engage the Zoltan there.''
#** Fight a [[Zoltan Ships|Zoltan ship]].
#*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|The Mantis are so grateful that they only take three quarters of the loot, leaving the rest for you. How civilized.}}
#**** You receive low [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
#*** {{Winning|deadCrew=true|The Mantis are so grateful that they only take three quarters of the loot, leaving the rest for you. How civilized.}}
#**** You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
# Interfere and help the Zoltan ship.
#* ''You overtake the Zoltan and catch up with the Mantis ship in the asteroid belt. Time to make some friends.''
#** Fight a [[Mantis Ships|Mantis ship]] with crew entirely composed of Mantis.
#*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|As you're salvaging the Mantis wreck the Zoltan security patrol returns with three other ships. You quickly salvage what you can and set off before they can stop you for questioning.}}
#**** You receive low [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
#*** {{Winning|deadCrew=true|As you're salvaging the Mantis wreck the Zoltan security patrol returns with three other ships. You quickly salvage what you can and set off before they can stop you for questioning.}}
#**** You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
# Don't interfere.
#* ''The Zoltan know their business better than most - best to leave them to it. You prepare to jump.''
#** Nothing happens.

==Trivia==
This event is called "ZOLTAN_DISTRESS_MANTIS" in the datafiles.
